source_text: Male circumcision, by contrast, yields documented protective effects, including a 50-60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition per three randomized controlled trials in Africa involving over 10,000 participants, alongside decreased human papillomavirus transmission and balanitis risk, without equivalent long-term morbidity when conducted neonatally under medical standards.
